experiment.scientific_question: Does the locked chirp plus 0.5 s passive ring-down policy retain low false-safe performance on a completely independent target population and seed set?
experiment.title: Stage 1 locked passive-policy independent replication

future_contact_maneuver.description: identical hidden sustained-contact maneuver to EXP-0005

primary_metrics.safe_precision_definition: actual SAFE divided by all predicted SAFE

boundary_enrichment.selection_rule: From the independent candidate pool, separately select SAFE and NON-SAFE targets with the smallest absolute log ratio between true hidden-maneuver severity and the unchanged SAFE envelope. Selection uses physical truth only, never a locked-policy prediction, and supplies no fitting data.

stage1_replication_criterion.rule: Stage 1 may proceed to independent MATLAB/Simulink validation only if the immutable policy bundle passes all nominal/high overall and boundary false-safe confidence limits, binary accuracy/precision/recall limits, population-degradation checks, integrity checks, and probe safety checks. Secondary CAUTION/UNSAFE confusion does not veto progression unless it creates a SAFE prediction for a truly NON-SAFE target.
